q_en:
Select the most appropriate adjective to fill in the blank.

She received a ____________ gift on her birthday.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate adjective to fill in the blank.

She received a ____________ gift on her birthday.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The correct option is 3. 'Surprising' is a present participle adjective that logically modifies the noun 'gift' based on the given answer key. 'Happily' and 'quickly' are adverbs, hence incorrect.

Solution (HI):
सही विकल्प 3 है। 'Surprising' (आश्चर्यजनक) एक विशेषण (adjective) है जो संज्ञा 'gift' की विशेषता बताने के लिए प्रयुक्त हुआ है। 'Happily' और 'quickly' क्रियाविशेषण (adverbs) हैं, इसलिए वे गलत हैं।

q_en:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is required, select ‘No article required’.

The story was very explicit, and it did not leave anything to _____ imagination.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is required, select ‘No article required’.

The story was very explicit, and it did not leave anything to _____ imagination.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The correct option is 3. The phrase 'leave something to the imagination' is a standard English idiom meaning to not fully disclose all details. Thus, the definite article 'the' is used.

Solution (HI):
सही विकल्प 3 है। अंग्रेजी में 'leave something to the imagination' एक स्थापित मुहावरा (idiom) है, जिसका अर्थ होता है कि किसी चीज के सभी विवरण प्रकट न करना। इस मुहावरे के निश्चित रूप में आर्टिकल 'the' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।

q_en:
Select the most appropriate punctuation mark to fill in the blank.

Slowly_____ she entered her mother’s room and sat on the cot.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate punctuation mark to fill in the blank.

Slowly_____ she entered her mother’s room and sat on the cot.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The correct option is 1. A comma is placed immediately after an introductory adverb (like 'Slowly') at the beginning of a sentence to mark a slight structural pause.

Solution (HI):
सही विकल्प 1 है। वाक्य के आरंभ में आने वाले परिचयात्मक क्रियाविशेषण (introductory adverb) जैसे 'Slowly' के ठीक बाद एक संक्षिप्त ठहराव या विराम दर्शाने के लिए अल्पविराम (, - comma) का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

q_en:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is needed, select 'No article needed'.
Mary said, "I wish to live in __________ largest house which is situated near the river bank."
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is needed, select 'No article needed'.
Mary said, "I wish to live in __________ largest house which is situated near the river bank."
solution:
Solution (EN):
The correct option is 3. Superlative degree adjectives (like 'largest') are always preceded by the definite article 'the' when identifying a specific item.

Solution (HI):
सही विकल्प 3 है। सुपरलेटिव डिग्री वाले विशेषणों (superlative adjectives) जैसे 'largest' के पहले हमेशा निश्चित आर्टिकल 'the' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

q_en:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She is a _______ lady.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She is a _______ lady.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The correct option is 1. The presence of the indefinite article 'a' indicates that a positive degree adjective is required to qualify the singular noun 'lady'. 'Lovely' fits perfectly.

Solution (HI):
सही विकल्प 1 है। वाक्य में प्रयुक्त इंडेफिनिट आर्टिकल 'a' दर्शाता है कि यहाँ एकवचन संज्ञा 'lady' की विशेषता बताने के लिए पॉजिटिव डिग्री के विशेषण की आवश्यकता है, इसलिए 'lovely' सही उत्तर है।

While it has greatly enhanced convenience, connectivity and access to information, it has also introduced concerns about mental health and social isolation. On the positive side, technological advancements in medicine, education and communication have led to significant improvements in quality of life. Experts argue that a mindful approach to technology usage, incorporating time for physical activities and social connections, is essential for the overall well-being. As society continues to evolve, it is crucial that individuals and institutions work together to ensure that technology remains a tool for improvement rather than a source of detriment.
